# Vendored libraries

These files are committed so the page has no runtime dependency on a CDN. Update by downloading the same paths from jsDelivr and replacing the files and versions here.

| File | Library | Version | License | Source |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `d3.v7.min.js` | D3.js | 7.9.0 | ISC (see `d3.LICENSE.txt`) | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js |
| `topojson-client.min.js` | topojson-client | 3.1.0 | ISC (see `topojson-client.LICENSE.txt`) | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/dist/topojson-client.min.js |

Boundary data under `data/` is derived from Natural Earth (public domain); see `tools/ne-version.json`.
